bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; q="SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public_post_drafts p JOIN announcement_posts a ON a.owner_user_id=p.owner_user_id AND a.kind='recruitment' AND a.status='published' AND a.conditions->>'dmScreenMessageId'=p.data->>'screenMessageId' WHERE p.module='announcement' AND p.step='cancelled' AND p.data->>'recruitmentFlow'='compact' AND p.data->>'screenMessageId' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$' AND p.updated_at > NOW()-INTERVAL '4 hours'"; n=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -tAqc "$q" | tr -d '[:space:]'); case "$n" in 1) exit 0;; 0) exit 81;; 2|3|4|5|6|7|8|9) exit 82;; *) exit 83;; esac
